name: TESSERA Genomics GeneClinic Worker Full Rig
description: Teal bioseal scrubs with gene-compatible hip and tail-channel vents sewn into the back panel, worn under a transparent sterile overgown with color-coded hemline indicators for contamination zones. A close-fitting respirator hood with a clear face panel seals at the collar and filters aerosol and genetic particulate. Double-layered geneware-safe gloves — inner bioskin, outer polymer — allow tactile sensitivity during cell-handling. Sealed slip-on boots in antimicrobial white rubber complete the ensemble, and a hip-slung specimen tray holds labeled culture plates and a gene-reader wand.
functionality: Respirator hood filters genetic particulate to 0.1 micron; gene-compatible hip and tail vents allow unobstructed movement for workers with geneware modifications.
what_it_says: This person handles the raw material of identity every shift, and the protocol is the only thing standing between a therapeutic and a catastrophe.
story_hooks: The specimen tray holds a culture plate with no patient ID — just a handwritten symbol that matches a Shelf-based gene-cult's sigil.
The respirator hood's filter log shows it processed an unregistered aerosol compound during last Tuesday's shift, and no incident report was filed.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sterile, clinical silhouette dominated by teal and translucent layers. The wearer appears encased in protective geometry—a figure optimized for contamination control rather than fashion. The clear overgown creates a ghostly second skin, while the respirator hood gives an almost alien quality. The hip-mounted specimen tray and gene-reader wand mark this unmistakably as working biotech.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fit base scrubs hugging the torso; oversized sterile overgown worn loose for donning/doffing efficiency. The respirator hood is snug at the neck, sealing against skin. Gloves and boots fitted precisely to prevent gaps. Overall silhouette is rectangular and utilitarian—form serves function entirely.
physical_description.primary_material: Teal bioseal synthetic weave (scrubs); transparent medical-grade polymer overgown; medical-grade respirator fabric with silicone seals; double-layer glove system (inner bioskin latex, outer reinforced polymer); antimicrobial vulcanized rubber boots
physical_description.texture: Scrubs: smooth, slightly grippy bioseal weave. Overgown: slick, crinkly transparent plastic with faint anti-static texture. Respirator: ribbed silicone seals contrasting smooth filter mesh. Gloves: inner latex powdery-soft, outer polymer slightly tacky. Boots: dense, smooth rubber with subtle grip treads.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary teal (scrubs and undershirt), pure white (boots, glove underlayers), clear/transparent (overgown with color-coded hemline striping—red, yellow, green zones indicating contamination gradients). Small chrome accents on specimen tray and gene-reader wand.
physical_description.closures: Overgown: rear velcro seals and friction-fit front overlap. Respirator: locking collar seal with twist-lock mechanism. Gloves: elastic wrist cuffs over gown sleeves. Boots: slip-on with interior grip lining. Specimen tray: magnetic attachment to hip seal-ring.
distinctive_features: Gene-compatible hip and tail-channel vents in rear scrub panel (for variant morphologies)
Clear respirator hood face panel with internal anti-fog coating
Color-coded hemline contamination zones visible through transparent overgown
Double-glove system allowing tactile feedback during cell work
Integrated hip specimen tray with magnetic culture plate holders
Gene-reader wand holstered on right hip (retractable tether)
TESSERA Genomics embroidered patch on left chest
Aerosol/particulate filter cartridges visible on respirator sides
Seamless boot-to-gown seal with integrated ankle cuff
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 boundary. The outfit itself is premium (TESSERA corp labwear), but signals working-class biotech labor, not executive status. Expensive but worn by wage earners.
physical_description.cultural_context: Medical/biotech worker identity. Wearing this rig signals competence in genetic and cellular work, institutional affiliation with a major genomics corp, and daily exposure to hazardous biologics. The wearer is credentialed, employed, and bound by strict contamination protocols. Not corpo elite, but trusted specialist.
physical_description.condition_typical: Meticulously maintained. Any visible wear (faint discoloration, micro-tears) triggers replacement under TESSERA safety protocols. Scrubs show faint creasing from repeated sterilization cycles. The overgown is typically pristine per shift—disposed and replaced hourly. Gloves show latex powder residue. Boots maintain their antimicrobial sheen.

image_prompt: A figure in full TESSERA Genomics biotech labwear stands in a sterile white clinic environment under cold fluorescent lighting. Teal bioseal scrubs visible beneath a translucent protective overgown with color-coded contamination zones (red-yellow-green hemline stripes) glowing faintly.
